requirements.evidence: app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:26-53 authorizes via `Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('create', [Queue::class, $entity])`, trims/slugifies, enforces per-entity slug uniqueness and turns `UniqueConstraintViolationException` into `ValidationException`; app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:33-69 takes named nullable `name`/`slug`/`isActive`, ignores the queue's own slug and maps a race to `ValidationException`; app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:33-79 authorizes `manageAccess`, rejects unknown/non-string permissions before any write, rejects cross-entity membership/queue, upserts or deletes, and logs `queue.access.granted`/`revoked` with `actor_id`/`queue_id`/`entity_membership_id`, skipping the revoke log when no row was deleted; app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:17-70 implements `create`/`update`/`manageAccess`/`call` (employees need a grant on that queue, non-array permissions deny); app/Models/Ticket.php:94-127 and app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:32 enforce lock -> `InactiveQueueException` -> authorize -> waiting check, matching the stated order; enum/model/factory/migration match the contract (app/Enums/QueuePermission.php:5-8, app/Models/QueueAccess.php:11-43, database/factories/QueueAccessFactory.php:23-32, database/migrations/2026_10_29_045614_create_queue_access_table.php:12-30); docs and CHANGELOG updated.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes live in app/Actions/* and authorize inside the action (CreateQueue.php:26, UpdateQueue.php:33, SetQueueAccess.php:33); authorization only via Gate/QueuePolicy, no UI checks; the migration is generator-shaped with a reversible `down()` (database/migrations/2026_10_29_045614_create_queue_access_table.php:28-30); mass assignment is deliberate via `#[Fillable([...])]` (app/Models/QueueAccess.php:11), matching the existing Ticket model; docs kept in sync (docs/business-rules.md, docs/database-schema.md, CHANGELOG.md under Added); Pest tests added with `uses(RefreshDatabase::class)` and a shared `memberWithRole` helper (tests/Pest.php:58).

security.evidence: Every write path authorizes before validating or touching data (app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:26, app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:33, app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:33) and both call paths now gate the caller (app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:32, app/Models/Ticket.php:113); untrusted input is validated (name/slug rules, `QueuePermission::tryFrom` loop at SetQueueAccess.php:35-41, entity match at 43-47) and `isActive` is typed bool; `#[Fillable]` restricts mass assignment (QueueAccess.php:11); a corrupted/non-array `permissions` payload is denied (QueuePolicy.php:58-64); no views or unescaped output in the diff, and no secrets are exposed.

tests.evidence: Meaningful coverage of the requirements and failure paths: tests/Feature/CreateQueueTest.php:38-105 (trim/slugify, 1..255, duplicates in/out of entity, unique-index race, authorization-first, no delete action), tests/Feature/UpdateQueueTest.php:18-125 (named args/no-op, own vs foreign slug, race, deactivation keeps tickets and blocks issuing), tests/Feature/SetQueueAccessTest.php:26-143 (upsert/revoke, audit exactly once, invalid/non-string permissions store nothing, cross-entity rejection, self-grant denial, cascade), tests/Feature/QueuePolicyTest.php:19-100 (roles, per-queue grant, corrupted permissions, factory entity match), tests/Feature/CallNextTicketTest.php:256-306 (employee grant, denial in every CallMode, inactive-before-auth) and tests/Feature/IssueTicketTest.php:182-215 (grant, inactive before auth, auth before already-called).

simplicity.evidence: The actions are short, reuse Eloquent/Validator and add no service/repository layer (app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:26-53, app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:33-69), but the slug-uniqueness rule plus race-to-`ValidationException` handling is duplicated almost verbatim between CreateQueue.php:30-49 and UpdateQueue.php:35-67, and the extra `lockForUpdate` transaction in UpdateQueue.php:56-62 goes slightly beyond what the task requires.

readability.evidence: Clear class/method names, small focused methods and helpful docblocks (app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:25-33, app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:24-66, app/Models/Ticket.php:81-93); the one wrinkle is UpdateQueue.php:45-50, where `array_filter` plus `array_intersect_key($rules, $input)` validate only supplied fields in a way that needs a second read.

scope.evidence: Everything in the diff serves the task: queue lifecycle actions, queue_access schema/model/factory/enum, QueuePolicy, enforcement in both call paths, and the required docs; the only comment edit in app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:35-37 is needed because Ticket::call() now takes the queue lock; no Livewire/HTTP UI, no extra permissions and no delete action.

issues.explanation: The per-entity slug uniqueness rule and the catch that converts `UniqueConstraintViolationException` to `ValidationException` are duplicated nearly verbatim in both actions and could share a rule or helper.
Filtering nulls with `array_filter` and then intersecting the rules with the input keys is correct but less obvious than building the rule array conditionally for the provided arguments.

Calling UpdateQueue with all three arguments null still runs an `update([])` inside the transaction, which bumps `updated_at` (and fires update events) instead of being a literal no-op; the values stay unchanged, so the impact is negligible.

review.summary: The change implements the queue lifecycle actions, the queue_access schema/model/factory/enum, and a single QueuePolicy enforced in both CallNextTicket and Ticket::call(), plus the required docs and broad Pest coverage. All task requirements and contracts are met with consistent authorization and validation; only small nits (duplicated slug-race handling, a less obvious conditional-validation trick, and a no-op update touching `updated_at`) keep it short of a clean approval.
